lyrics_hindi: कौन कहता है भगवान आते नहीं
तुम मीरा के जैसे बुलाते नहीं
lyrics_english: Kaun Kehta Hai Bhagwaan Aate Nahi
Tum Meera Ke Jaise Bulate Nahi
description: A beautiful bhajan dedicated to Lord Krishna, describing his divine forms.

lyrics_hindi: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मन मुकुरु सुधारि
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि
बल बुद्धि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार
lyrics_english: Shri Guru Charan Saroj Raj Nij Man Mukur Sudhari
Barnau Raghubar Bimal Jasu Jo Dayaku Phal Chari
Buddhihin Tanu Janike Sumirau Pavan Kumar
Bal Buddhi Vidya Dehu Mohin Harahu Kalesh Bikaar
description: The famous 40-verse prayer dedicated to Lord Hanuman, composed by Tulsidas.
